_comment: The GNOME lines this project audits, and the container each one can be opened in. Fedora ships one GNOME line per release, so a release image is a line. `base` is what tools/Containerfile builds from and `image` is the built tag verify-line.sh runs; `expects` is the prefix the container's `gnome-shell --version` must start with, checked before anything is measured, so a tag that has been moved or repointed fails loudly rather than quietly verifying a different line.
